rule_first_buy: First BUY print (lift ask) that rounds to a tick, held to official resolve.
rule_band: First BUY whose rounded price is inside [min, max] after the tail window opens. This is what favorite_min/max + favorite_window_seconds does.

pnl_compare.sizing: Each fill uses $25 / avg_px shares, 7% Polymarket fee, hold to official resolve. No daily circuit, no FOK misses, one fill per market.
honest: Dollar totals assume every qualifying 5m book fills at $25. Live FOK, scan_limit, and a $50 circuit cut this a lot.
90¢ last 5m unclipped is ~8× the circuit-stop daily PnL. One reverse still costs ~$25.
Wins to offset one $25 blowup: 90¢ 9.7, 96¢ 26, 98¢ 53, 99¢ 106. 99¢ sample does not cover.

no_water.rule: First BUY in band, $25 / price shares, 7% fee, hold to official resolve, one fill per 5m market. UTC-day PnL; after -$50 skip later fills that day. Still uses public prints (not live FOK), so fill rate remains optimistic.

answer.best_combo: 90¢ only, full 5 minutes (favorite_min=0.90, favorite_max=0.90, window=300 or 0 for 全段)
answer.runner_up: 91¢ only, full 5 minutes — almost same PnL, fewer halt days (3 vs 5)
what_was_removed: Tick double-count: bands only, one fill per market
$50 UTC-day circuit applied in time order (breaching fill still counts)
water_still_left: Fill = first public BUY print, not live FOK/FAK. Misses and worse prices not modeled.
Assumes the bot is looking at that 5m BTC book whenever the print happens.
answer.why_not_37_per_day: The earlier ~$37/day estimate treated circuit as 'stop after 2 losses from zero'. Live circuit is net today_pnl <= -$50. Wins buffer; 90¢ only halted 5 of 31 days. Circuit haircut on 90¢ is 15% ($8520 → $7268), not 8×.

recommendation.sample: BTC 5m, 14d, 4007 resolved, first BUY print in window, 7% fee, hold to official resolve

safest_tick_if_you_can_fill.why: Lowest reverse rate among taker combos whose 95% CI still clears fee breakeven. Reverse 1.43%, wr 98.57%, +0.44¢/share. 98¢ last 30/45s is −EV. 99¢ never clears breakeven as a taker BUY.

best_ev_tick.why: Highest pnl/share among large-n BUY rows. Reverse 2.55% but win pays ~4.7¢ vs 99¢ paying 0.93¢.

best_balance.why: 96¢ last 3 minutes: reverse ~2.0% (better than 95), EV +1.75¢/share (4× 98¢). CI clears breakeven cleanly. 25.8 wins offset one $25 blowup vs 53 at 98 and 106 at 99.

best_window.why: 180s and full 5m (300s) are almost the same tape. 900s adds nothing. Last 30–45s is adverse selection: 97/98/99 go −EV; 96 stays barely +EV; 95@30s is flat.

bot_settings_if_following_tape.note: Band 96–98, last 3 minutes. Skip 99 as taker. Do not stack. Snapshot-99 with 30s left is safer (0.11% reverse) but that ask is usually gone after itode.

recommendation.sample: BTC 5m, 30d, first BUY print in window, 7% fee, hold to official resolve

bot_settings_if_following_tape.note: Keep 96–98 last 3 minutes unless 30d tape flips 98 last 180s to −EV. Skip 99 as taker.

safest_tick_if_you_can_fill.why: Lowest reverse among large-n taker combos whose 95% CI still clears fee breakeven.

best_balance.why: 96¢ last 3 minutes: more edge per share than 98, lower reverse than 95.

best_window.why: 180s ≈ full 5m. Last 30–45s is leftover size / adverse selection.

recommendation.vs_14d: The extra 16 days were choppier. Last-180s reverse rose: 95¢ 2.58%→3.26%, 96¢ 1.99%→2.47%, 97¢ 1.82%→2.23%, 98¢ 1.43%→1.71%, 99¢ 1.12%→1.17%. 98¢ last 180s is still +0.16¢/share but the 95% CI no longer clears fee breakeven. 99¢ last 180s CI [98.58%, 99.04%] sits entirely below the 99.07% wr needed. 96–97 last 3 minutes remain the robust +EV band; skip taker 99; avoid last 30–45s.

recommendation.sample: BTC 5m, 30d, first BUY in band after window opens, 7% fee, hold to official resolve
recommendation.avoid: Last 30–45s from 93¢ up. Taker 99¢. 15m books. 90–92 full session while daily_loss_limit is $50.

bot_settings_if_following_tape.why: Keep 96–98 last 3 minutes. 90–92 last 5m wins on EV but blowups trip a $50 circuit. 97 last 3 min is the fewest steamrolls. Do not add 99.

playbook.best_no_water: 90¢ only, full 5 minutes (favorite_min=0.90, favorite_max=0.90, window=300 or 0 for 全段)
playbook.pnl_note: After $50 circuit in time order: 90¢ full 5m +$7,268 / 31d (+$234/day), 15% below unclipped. Current 96-98 last 180s +$1,166 (+$38/day). 91¢ full 5m +$7,120 with only 3 halt days. 99¢ still negative. Last water: print ≠ FOK.

best_no_water.why: Max 30d PnL after $50 UTC-day circuit, $25/fill, one fill per market, band first BUY. Prints still optimistic vs live FOK.

honest: A wide cheap band (90–99 last 5m) fills at the first 90¢ print, then has the whole window to get steamrolled.
99¢ is not certain. One dump after you lift is −~99¢/share vs +~0.93¢ if you win.
Prints that already traded are not a 250ms FAK fill. Live fill rate is lower.
5m books can trade before the BTC window; this study keeps last 900s of tape only.
